D021.key_difference: Presence of fear of weight gain

D021: Depressive symptoms may appear along with food restriction and weight loss, and intense fear of gaining weight is accompanied.
D013: Food restriction and weight loss may appear along with depressive symptoms, but intense fear of gaining weight is not accompanied.

D021.key_difference: Distorted perception and fear regarding eating/body shape

D021: Distorted perception regarding eating and body shape may be at a delusional level, but this is based on the fear of gaining weight.
D005: Peculiar eating behaviors and weight loss may appear, but these are unrelated to fear of weight/body shape changes, and other symptoms of schizophrenia are accompanied.

D021: Obsessive thoughts and behaviors related to food occur due to fear of weight gain and body shape distortion.
D016: Obsessive thoughts and behaviors related to food may appear, but fear of weight gain or body shape distortion do not exist.

D021.key_difference: Scope of appearance preoccupation and compulsive behaviors

D021: Preoccupation with appearance is limited to body shape and weight.
D017: Preoccupation with appearance may include other body parts (nose, skin, facial features, etc.) besides body shape/weight, and compulsive behaviors appear.

D021.additional_condition: Presence of Binge Eating and Purging Behaviors

D021: May be accompanied by binge eating and purging behaviors, and weight is significantly low (underweight status).
D022: Accompanied by binge eating and purging behaviors, but weight is maintained at least at or above a normal level.
